Seaborne et al. [@seaborne2018] investigated whether human skeletal muscle retains an epigenetic memory of earlier hypertrophic loading. Genomic DNA was extracted from *vastus lateralis* biopsies obtained from eight untrained men at five time-points; baseline, immediately after an acute bout of resistance exercise (*acute*), after seven weeks of resistance training (*loading*), after seven weeks of training cessation (*unloading*), and after a further seven weeks of retraining (*reloading*). Genome-wide DNA methylation was profiled on the Illumina Infinium MethylationEPIC BeadChip (GPL21145, ~850,000 CpG sites) and the data were deposited in the Gene Expression Omnibus under accession GSE114763.
